meta_title: OpenDrone owners map: where the boards fly
meta_description: Where OpenDrone owners are, by country and US state, in coarse buckets. Published only where at least 5 owners live, never exact counts.
title: Where OpenDrone owners are.
lead: A map of the people who bought and flew OpenDrone hardware, by country and US state. Only regions with at least 5 owners appear, and only as a range.
fixture_note: Sample numbers for local development, not real owners.
map_aria: World map of OpenDrone owners by country, with the United States by state. The same figures are listed below the map.
map_failed: The map could not be loaded. The regions are listed below.
readout_other: {name}: {range} owners, regions too small to show alone
empty: The map appears once enough owners have ordered. Regions with fewer than 5 owners are never shown.
how_body: An owner is a customer with at least one paid order that included physical goods, counted once, by the country the order shipped to. For the United States we also count by state.

A country or state is published only when it has at least 5 owners, and then as a range (5-9, 10-24, 25-49, 50-99, 100-249, 250-499 or 500+), never an exact number. Smaller countries are pooled into Other countries, smaller US states into Other US states, and a pool is shown only when it too reaches 5.

The totals above are rounded down to the nearest 10. Every 30 days the shop recomputes the figures and keeps only that published result: orders and addresses are not stored for the map. The legal basis and your rights are in the [privacy policy](/privacy).
pilot_lead: Owners can put themselves on a map to find others to fly with. It is optional, shows a Discord username and an area of about 10 km, and only signed-in OpenDrone owners can see it.
